newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech unions extend railway strike 24 hours.
newsitem.headline: Czech unions extend railway strike 24 hours.

text.p: The leader of the unions representing Czech railway workers said on Wednesday the national rail strike, scheduled to end at midnight tonight, would continue another 24 hours, the CTK news agency reported.
It quoted Jaromir Dusek, chairman of the Association of Unions of Czech Railway Workers (OSZ), as saying that OSZ's strike committee had voted to continue the action.
